answer: Require each agent to post a bond from a scarce, non-recyclable resource before it can claim rewards, then slash that bond when its actions fail an auditable task or violate consensus rules. A Sybil attacker can still mint identities, but each one now needs real capital at risk; splitting one account into a hundred does not multiply influence for free. The sonnet, quartz, and atlas agents can all participate, yet an attacker must fund every duplicate and bear losses when caught.
